measurements.required_input: exchangeInfo exact perp metadata
measurements.definition: venue/native symbol/USDT settle/type/status; multiplier never inferred; tick and lot Decimal alignment

measurements.required_input: fresh book, turnover, declared native depth and friction assumptions
measurements.definition: 10000*(ask-bid)/mid; declared depth USDT within bps; native lot/min notional and current book walk

measurements.definition: max(H-L,abs(H-Cprev),abs(L-Cprev)); first sample undefined

measurements.required_input: 14 valid TRs then recurrence
measurements.definition: seed=sum(TR1..14)/14; ATR=(13*ATRprev+TR)/14
measurements.prior_anchor: fixed source start; original ATR frozen in Reference
measurements.test_oracle: Exact seed/recurrence, zero ATR, retained native-atr failures

measurements.required_input: n=16 closed H/L/C
measurements.definition: (maxH-minL)/max(C,tick)
measurements.test_oracle: Independent width arithmetic and genuine selected bars

measurements.required_input: 128 earlier width windows

measurements.required_input: n+1 closed closes
measurements.definition: abs(Ct-Ct-n)/sum(abs(diff C)); zero path UNKNOWN

measurements.required_input: two aligned bars and tick

measurements.test_oracle: Inherited independent geometry/flat tests

measurements.required_input: previous ATR and two closed bars
measurements.definition: TR/ATRprev; abs(C-O)/max(H-L,tick); (C-L)/max(range,tick); signed progress
measurements.test_oracle: Wick negative, positive displacement, zero ATR

measurements.required_input: l/r in 2,3,4; contiguous bars
measurements.definition: strict left high and non-strict right high; mirror lows; confirm only at k+r
measurements.test_oracle: Tied pivots and known-at prefix tests

measurements.required_input: confirmed swings/predeclared range/old zone
measurements.definition: immutable bounds, tick/ATR, origin/source IDs, known/available/expiry
measurements.prior_anchor: original Reference id and source graph
measurements.test_oracle: Future prefix, ledger immutability, expiry/source mismatch

measurements.required_input: valid pre-known opposite references and current source price
measurements.definition: distance=max(lo-p,p-hi,0)/ATRref; nearest directional obstacle; consumption never skipped
measurements.test_oracle: Inherited consumed first obstacle/room failures

measurements.required_input: frozen zone/buffer and ordered closed bars
measurements.definition: overlap zone +/- max(2ticks,.15ATR); next episode only after fully separated .5ATR retreat
measurements.prior_anchor: same frozen zone; no same-bar path
measurements.test_oracle: Noisy repeated touches and separate episodes

measurements.required_input: ordered confirmed high/low ladder and pre-known protected swing
measurements.definition: HH/HL or LH/LL; buffered close BOS; first opposing CHoCH; prior sweep plus displacement MSS candidate
measurements.prior_anchor: original protected swing and ladder known before break
measurements.test_oracle: M02 independent MSS positive/wick negative; F1 ladder tests

measurements.definition: Q/median(Qprev32); zero median UNKNOWN
measurements.test_oracle: Zero baseline/optional failure isolation/genuine quote_volume receipts
measurements.unknown: Optional scope may be budget omitted

measurements.required_input: exact matching kline buy quote/base volumes
measurements.definition: deltaQ=2BQ-Q; deltaB=2BV-V; imbalanceQ=deltaQ/Q; anchored sum deltaQ
measurements.test_oracle: Inherited unit arithmetic and source pairs
measurements.unknown: Bar aggressor facts are not footprint

measurements.required_input: complete same-anchor CVD and two confirmed swings
measurements.definition: lower price low with higher CVD low; mirror high; available at second right confirmation
measurements.test_oracle: Independent positive/negative and delayed confirmation

measurements.required_input: complete base/quote bars from pre-known UTC/event anchor
measurements.definition: sum Q / sum V; zero V unknown; exact whole-bar first moment
measurements.prior_anchor: anchor known no later than first included bar open
measurements.test_oracle: Mixed volume, reset, post-hoc anchor rejection

measurements.required_input: whole-bar value, prior residuals, or actual tape second moment
measurements.definition: distance=(C-VWAP)/ATRref; z_close=residual/sigma prior16 residuals; true tape sum((p-mean)^2*v)/sumv separately
measurements.prior_anchor: expanding Q/V prefix; evaluation excluded from sigma
measurements.test_oracle: Exact residual distinction and executed variance=3 oracle
measurements.unknown: True weighted bands require qualified tape

measurements.required_input: complete declared venue/window executed price-volume tape
measurements.definition: fixed bins; POC tie lower; greedy contiguous70% VA adjacent tie lower; MEAN3 nodes, separation3
measurements.prior_anchor: frozen completed profile/version; contiguous first revisit
measurements.test_oracle: Independent POC/VA/ties/nodes/revisit and OHLC/partial rejection

measurements.required_input: time-aligned alt/BTC/ETH/peer closes
measurements.definition: log(Ct/Ct-h) difference; matched windows required
measurements.test_oracle: Alignment negative and source-relative regressions

measurements.required_input: aligned historical asset/benchmark returns
measurements.definition: beta=Cov/Var trained n32 ending t-1; alpha=meanY-beta*meanX; later residuals; persistent3 signs
measurements.test_oracle: Known beta=2, OOS residual, zero benchmark variance, signed F8

measurements.required_input: dated contract-linked memberships and aligned peer residuals
measurements.definition: own residual minus median of at least5 other mapped peers
measurements.prior_anchor: membership known/valid intervals and same measurement cutoff
measurements.test_oracle: Five peers positive; four/stale/missing unknown
measurements.unknown: No current dated perp-sector source qualified

measurements.required_input: native OI multiplier/mark and funding kind/actual interval/index
measurements.definition: native/base/USDT deltas; exact logUSDT=logbase+logmark; fractional funding and aligned mark/index basis
measurements.prior_anchor: synchronized mark/OI; predicted versus settled explicitly
measurements.test_oracle: 1000 multiplier decomposition/no side; interval and mark mismatch
measurements.unknown: Full unit metadata and actual funding interval need source qualification

measurements.required_input: timestamped witnessed forced executions and feed coverage
measurements.definition: sum actual price*base in declared window; sampled retained; modeled clusters never observed total
measurements.test_oracle: Observed200 USDT, sampled/model separation, duplicate rejection

measurements.required_input: same-window eligible/evaluable cross-section returns
measurements.definition: up share/outperform share; global median/MAD; explicit eligible/evaluable/missing denominators
measurements.prior_anchor: frozen aligned source cutoff and full identity snapshot
measurements.test_oracle: Inherited synchronization, denominator, advisory non-veto tests

measurements.required_input: original publisher, publication/first-known/receipt times and contract mapping
measurements.definition: published <= first_known <= received <= evaluation; exact impacted perp mapping
measurements.test_oracle: Unicode identity and inverted-time negatives
